segments.text:
V. 4.
In him was life.—He was the Foundation of Life to every living Thing, as well as of Being to all that is. And the life was the light of men—He who is effential Life, and the Giver of Life to all that liveth, was alſo the Light of Men; the Fountain of Wiſdom, Holineſs, and Happineſs, to Man in his Original State.
